Whose Shadow Is It? Rules

A picture is shown with several black shadows. Tap the shadow that belongs to the picture.

The rules

The goal
A game has 6 pictures. Under each picture there are black shadows, and exactly one of them has the outline of the picture. Tap it. Then tap Next for the following picture.
Right and wrong
The right shadow gets a double frame. A wrong shadow is crossed out and you can try another one. There is no time limit; only the mistakes are counted.
Levels
Easy: three shadows of things that look quite different. Medium: four shadows of things from the same group, for example four animals. Hard: four shadows, and two of them are the same picture turned around, upside down or on its side.
Hint
The hint marks the right shadow. A game with a hint counts as solved all the same.

Example

The picture is a sun with rays. Its shadow is a round black shape with rays - not the black square.
